#4201 Password reset email links to localhost
Opened by mkowalczyk on 2026-09-08

I clicked "Forgot password" on the login page. The email arrived within a
minute, but the link in it goes to

    http://localhost:3000/reset-password?token=…

which of course doesn't load for me. Two people on my team

input.body:
label: bug
file: src/email/templates.ts

The password reset link is built from `BASE_URL`, which falls back to `http://localhost:3000` whenever the `PUBLIC_URL` environment variable isn't set:

    const BASE_URL = process.env.PUBLIC_URL ?? "http://localhost:3000";

If the production deployment doesn't have `PUBLIC_URL` configured (or it was unset/misconfigured in last week's release), every generated link — password reset, weekly rollup, and scheduled export emails — will point at localhost instead of the real site. This matches what mkowalczyk and teammates are seeing. The fix is to ensure `PUBLIC_URL` is set in the production environment, and ideally to fail loudly (or use a safer default) when it's missing rather than silently falling back to localhost.
